title: Fitness
subtitle: 「體能／體適能／身體狀況」，要先分清是在談整體身體狀態、健康、耐力、肌力、心肺能力，還是運動員的競技準備狀態。
description: 「體能／體適能／身體狀況」，要先分清是在談整體身體狀態、健康、耐力、肌力、心肺能力，還是運動員的競技準備狀態。

words.example: Regular exercise can improve overall physical condition.
words.exampleZh: 定期運動可以改善整體身體狀況。

exercises.original: Regular exercise can improve overall fitness.
exercises.zh: 定期運動可以改善整體身體狀況。
exercises.upgrade: Regular exercise can improve overall physical condition.

options.explanation: overall bodily state is exactly what physical condition describes。
weight is only one measurement and does not show overall ability。
slimness is appearance/body size, not physical performance。
muscle only is one component。
exercise is the activity that improves fitness, not the condition itself。
health only is broader and does not specifically describe physical capability.

exercises.original: His fitness improved after several months of rehabilitation.
exercises.zh: 經過數月復康後，他的身體狀況有所改善。
exercises.upgrade: His physical condition improved after several months of rehabilitation.

options.explanation: rehabilitation + overall improvement supports physical condition。
weight may change but is not the whole result。
exercise is the intervention, not the resulting condition。
strength/stamina each cover only one dimension。
slimness is not a rehabilitation fitness measure.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The medical check assessed her general fitness before surgery.
exercises.zh: 手術前的醫療檢查評估她的一般身體狀況。
exercises.upgrade: The medical check assessed her general physical condition before surgery.

options.explanation: pre-surgery medical assessment considers broad physical condition。
exercise is a behaviour, not what the check assesses overall。
body weight is one metric。
muscle is only one physical feature。
slimness is not a medical readiness measure。
stamina alone is too narrow.

words.example: Walking regularly can improve both fitness and general health.
words.exampleZh: 定期步行可以改善體能和整體健康。

exercises.original: Walking regularly can improve fitness and reduce disease risk.
exercises.zh: 定期步行可以改善健康並降低疾病風險。
exercises.upgrade: Walking regularly can improve health and reduce disease risk.

options.explanation: disease risk is a direct clue for the broader concept health。
strength/stamina are narrower fitness components。
weight is only one factor。
exercise is the activity, not the outcome state。
slimness does not equal lower disease risk.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The programme aims to improve the fitness of older adults through diet and exercise.
exercises.zh: 計劃透過飲食和運動改善長者健康。
exercises.upgrade: The programme aims to improve the health of older adults through diet and exercise.

options.explanation: diet + exercise + older adults suggests broad health improvement。
stamina/strength are only parts of fitness。
weight only is too narrow。
muscle is one factor。
exercise is one method, not the overall outcome.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Poor sleep can affect fitness as well as mood.
exercises.zh: 睡眠不足可以影響健康和情緒。
exercises.upgrade: Poor sleep can affect health as well as mood.

options.explanation: sleep affects broad health and mood, not merely physical performance。
strength/stamina are too narrow。
slimness and weight are body-composition outcomes, not the full concept。
exercise is not a condition.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: Long-distance running can gradually build stamina.
words.exampleZh: 長跑可以逐步提升耐力。

exercises.original: Long-distance running can gradually improve fitness for sustained effort.
exercises.zh: 長跑可以逐步提升持續活動的耐力。
exercises.upgrade: Long-distance running can gradually build stamina.

options.explanation: sustained effort without fatigue is the defining meaning of stamina。
strength is force production, not prolonged effort。
weight/slimness do not measure endurance。
exercise is the activity itself。
health is much broader.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The hike tested everyone's fitness over several hours.
exercises.zh: 數小時的遠足考驗了大家的耐力。
exercises.upgrade: The hike tested everyone's stamina over several hours.

options.explanation: several hours of continued effort directly tests stamina。
strength only does not capture duration。
health is too broad。
weight is irrelevant to the specific capacity。
exercise is the hike itself, not the ability tested。
muscle mass does not equal endurance.

exercises.original: She needs more fitness to keep running at the same pace.
exercises.zh: 她需要更多耐力才能保持相同跑速。
exercises.upgrade: She needs more stamina to keep running at the same pace.

options.explanation: keep running at the same pace concerns endurance over time。
strength alone does not ensure sustained running。
slimness/weight do not directly determine this capacity。
health is broader。
exercise is the training behaviour.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The school introduced a programme to improve students' physical fitness.
words.exampleZh: 學校推出計劃提升學生的體適能。

exercises.original: The school introduced tests to measure students' fitness.
exercises.zh: 學校引入測試量度學生體適能。
exercises.upgrade: The school introduced tests to measure students' physical fitness.

options.explanation: formal school tests measuring endurance/strength etc. assess physical fitness。
exercise is what students do, not the measured condition。
weight alone is insufficient。
health is broader than fitness testing。
muscle only is one component。
slimness is not a fitness score.

exercises.original: The programme improved participants' fitness through regular activity.
exercises.zh: 計劃透過定期活動提升參加者體適能。
exercises.upgrade: The programme improved participants' physical fitness through regular activity.

options.explanation: regular activity improving a broad set of physical abilities is physical fitness。
health only is broader。
exercise is the intervention。
weight is one measurement。
strength/stamina alone are partial components.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The assessment measures fitness, flexibility, and balance.
exercises.zh: 評估量度體適能、柔軟度和平衡。
exercises.upgrade: The assessment measures physical fitness, flexibility, and balance.

options.explanation: assessment context benefits from the formal complete term physical fitness。
exercise is an activity。
weight/slimness are body-composition measures。
health is broader。
muscle does not capture all fitness domains.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The players returned early to improve their conditioning before the season.
words.exampleZh: 球員提早歸隊，以在賽季前改善體能狀態。

exercises.original: The players returned early to improve their fitness before the season.
exercises.zh: 球員提早歸隊，以在賽季前改善體能狀態。
exercises.upgrade: The players returned early to improve their conditioning before the season.

options.explanation: pre-season athletic preparation is classic conditioning context。
health is too broad。
weight/slimness are not the main goal。
exercise only is the activity rather than the developed readiness。
strength only covers one part of conditioning.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The coach said the team's fitness was below the required level.
exercises.zh: 教練表示球隊體能未達所需水平。
exercises.upgrade: The coach said the team's conditioning was below the required level.

options.explanation: coach + team + required physical readiness points to conditioning。
health is too broad and medical。
weight/muscle/slimness are isolated characteristics。
exercise is training behaviour, not state.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Extra running was added to improve fitness before competition.
exercises.zh: 比賽前增加跑步以改善體能。
exercises.upgrade: Extra running was added to improve conditioning before competition.

options.explanation: before competition + extra running is preparation for athletic conditioning。
exercise itself is the method, not the fitness state。
health is broader。
weight/slimness are not the central performance goal。
muscle only is too narrow.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: Cycling is useful for building cardiovascular endurance.
words.exampleZh: 踏單車有助提升心肺耐力。

exercises.original: Cycling is useful for improving fitness during long periods of exercise.
exercises.zh: 踏單車有助提升長時間運動所需的耐力。
exercises.upgrade: Cycling is useful for building endurance.

options.explanation: long-duration physical effort is exactly endurance。
strength is short-force capacity。
weight/slimness are body characteristics。
muscle only does not capture aerobic endurance。
health is broader.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The athlete's fitness over the final hour was impressive.
exercises.zh: 運動員最後一小時的耐力令人印象深刻。
exercises.upgrade: The athlete's endurance over the final hour was impressive.

options.explanation: final hour sustained performance is an endurance measure。
strength alone cannot explain prolonged effort。
health is too broad。
weight is not the ability being praised。
exercise is the activity itself。
slimness is irrelevant.

exercises.original: The training plan focuses on fitness for long-distance events.
exercises.zh: 訓練計劃集中提升長途項目所需耐力。
exercises.upgrade: The training plan focuses on endurance for long-distance events.

options.explanation: long-distance events directly require endurance。
strength/muscle size are different training goals。
weight is not a capacity。
health is broader。
flexibility only is too narrow and unrelated to sustained effort.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: Resistance training can improve muscular strength.
words.exampleZh: 阻力訓練可以提升肌力。

exercises.original: Resistance training improves fitness by making muscles stronger.
exercises.zh: 阻力訓練透過增強肌肉提升肌力。
exercises.upgrade: Resistance training improves strength by making muscles stronger.

options.explanation: muscles stronger directly defines strength。
stamina is endurance over time。
health is broader。
weight is a measurement。
exercise is the method。
slimness is appearance/body composition.

exercises.original: The test measures upper-body fitness using a lifting task.
exercises.zh: 測試透過負重任務量度上半身肌力。
exercises.upgrade: The test measures upper-body strength using a lifting task.

options.explanation: lifting task + upper body measures force capacity, i.e. strength。
stamina concerns sustained effort。
health is broader。
weight/slimness do not measure force production。
exercise is the activity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: She wants to improve fitness for carrying heavy equipment.
exercises.zh: 她想提升搬運重型設備所需的力量。
exercises.upgrade: She wants to improve strength for carrying heavy equipment.

options.explanation: carrying heavy equipment requires force, so strength is precise。
stamina matters for duration but not the core heavy-load capacity。
weight/slimness are not the ability。
health is broader。
exercise is the training method.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 心肺適能；心血管體適能
words.example: Brisk walking can improve cardiovascular fitness.
words.exampleZh: 快步行可以改善心肺適能。

exercises.original: Brisk walking can improve fitness of the heart and lungs.
exercises.zh: 快步行可以改善心肺適能。
exercises.upgrade: Brisk walking can improve cardiovascular fitness.

options.explanation: heart and lungs are the defining clue for cardiovascular fitness。
strength is muscular force。
muscle mass/weight/slimness are body-composition measures。
exercise is the activity itself.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The test measures how well the body uses oxygen during exercise.
exercises.zh: 測試量度身體運動時利用氧氣的能力。
exercises.upgrade: The test measures cardiovascular fitness during exercise.

options.explanation: oxygen delivery/use during sustained exercise is central to cardiovascular fitness。
strength concerns force。
weight/slimness/muscle do not directly measure oxygen capacity。
flexibility is range of motion.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Running three times a week improved his fitness for aerobic exercise.
exercises.zh: 每週跑步三次提升了他的心肺適能。
exercises.upgrade: Running three times a week improved his cardiovascular fitness.

options.explanation: regular running primarily develops heart-lung aerobic fitness。
strength is not the main adaptation。
weight/slimness are not equivalent to fitness。
muscle is too narrow。
balance is a different physical domain.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The rehabilitation programme improved patients' exercise capacity.
words.exampleZh: 復康計劃提升了病人的運動能力。

exercises.original: The rehabilitation programme improved patients' fitness for physical activity.
exercises.zh: 復康計劃提升病人的運動能力。
exercises.upgrade: The rehabilitation programme improved patients' exercise capacity.

options.explanation: rehabilitation + measurable ability to perform activity fits exercise capacity。
slimness/weight do not capture functional exertion ability。
strength only is one component。
health only is broader。
exercise itself is the intervention, not capacity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Heart disease reduced his fitness for walking uphill.
exercises.zh: 心臟病降低了他步行上斜路的活動耐受能力。
exercises.upgrade: Heart disease reduced his exercise capacity for walking uphill.

options.explanation: clinical disease + reduced ability to perform exertion is exercise capacity。
strength alone does not explain cardiovascular limitation。
weight/slimness are not the measured capacity。
exercise is the activity。
muscle is too narrow.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Doctors assessed her fitness using a treadmill test.
exercises.zh: 醫生用跑步機測試評估她的運動能力。
exercises.upgrade: Doctors assessed her exercise capacity using a treadmill test.

options.explanation: medical treadmill testing commonly assesses exercise capacity。
weight/slimness are separate measures。
strength only is not what treadmill tests mainly assess。
exercise routine is behaviour, not measured ability。
health only is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 運動狀態；競技體能狀態
words.example: The athlete returned to good athletic condition after rehabilitation.
words.exampleZh: 運動員在復康後恢復良好競技狀態。

exercises.original: The athlete returned to full fitness after rehabilitation.
exercises.zh: 運動員復康後恢復良好競技狀態。
exercises.upgrade: The athlete returned to good athletic condition after rehabilitation.

options.explanation: athlete + return after rehab + competitive readiness supports athletic condition。
general health may be good without competition readiness。
weight/slimness/muscle are isolated traits。
exercise is the activity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The coach was pleased with the players' fitness before the tournament.
exercises.zh: 教練對球員賽前競技體能狀態感到滿意。
exercises.upgrade: The coach was pleased with the players' athletic condition before the tournament.

options.explanation: coach + tournament + players' state points to athletic condition。
health is broader and not performance-specific。
weight/slimness are not overall readiness。
exercise is training activity。
stamina only is just one dimension.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: She is close to peak fitness ahead of the championships.
exercises.zh: 錦標賽前，她接近巔峰競技狀態。
exercises.upgrade: She is close to peak athletic condition ahead of the championships.

options.explanation: peak state before championships is an athletic-condition context。
health is broader and not performance-specific。
weight/slimness do not define peak condition。
exercise is the method。
strength only is one component.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 功能能力；身體活動能力
words.example: Strength training can help older adults maintain functional capacity.
words.exampleZh: 肌力訓練可以幫助長者維持日常活動能力。

exercises.original: Strength training helps older adults maintain fitness for daily tasks.
exercises.zh: 肌力訓練有助長者維持完成日常活動的能力。
exercises.upgrade: Strength training helps older adults maintain functional capacity for daily tasks.

options.explanation: daily tasks + older adults focuses functional capacity。
slimness/weight do not show task ability。
exercise is the intervention。
stamina only is too narrow。
health is broader.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The assessment measures fitness for climbing stairs and carrying shopping.
exercises.zh: 評估量度上樓梯和攜帶購物袋的日常活動能力。
exercises.upgrade: The assessment measures functional capacity for climbing stairs and carrying shopping.

options.explanation: real-world daily tasks are classic functional-capacity measures。
weight/slimness are not abilities。
exercise is activity, not capacity。
strength and cardiovascular fitness are contributors, but each alone is narrower than functional capacity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Illness reduced her fitness for normal daily activities.
exercises.zh: 疾病降低了她進行一般日常活動的能力。
exercises.upgrade: Illness reduced her functional capacity for normal daily activities.

options.explanation: ability to perform daily activities is exactly functional capacity。
exercise is behaviour。
weight/slimness/muscle are body features。
stamina only is one contributor.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 身體準備狀態；體能準備度
words.example: The assessment checks physical readiness for demanding field work.
words.exampleZh: 評估檢查人員是否具備從事高強度戶外工作的身體準備狀態。

exercises.original: The assessment checks fitness for demanding field work.
exercises.zh: 評估檢查人員是否具備高強度戶外工作的身體準備度。
exercises.upgrade: The assessment checks physical readiness for demanding field work.

options.explanation: readiness for a specific demanding task is the key clue。
weight/slimness are not readiness measures。
exercise is training behaviour。
health only is broader。
strength only covers one demand.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Recruits must demonstrate fitness before beginning the course.
exercises.zh: 新學員在開始課程前必須證明身體準備度。
exercises.upgrade: Recruits must demonstrate physical readiness before beginning the course.

options.explanation: recruits + before beginning a demanding course fits readiness assessment。
health can be good without task readiness。
weight/slimness/muscle alone are incomplete。
exercise is an activity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The test is designed to measure fitness for operational duties.
exercises.zh: 測試旨在量度執行職務所需的身體準備狀態。
exercises.upgrade: The test is designed to measure physical readiness for operational duties.

options.explanation: operational duties require specific physical readiness。
exercise is preparation, not readiness itself。
weight/slimness are not capacities。
stamina only is too narrow。
health only does not guarantee duty readiness.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 身體狀態良好；很有體能
words.example: She walks every day to stay in good shape.
words.exampleZh: 她每天步行以保持良好體能狀態。

exercises.original: She walks every day to maintain her fitness.
exercises.zh: 她每天步行以保持良好體能狀態。
exercises.upgrade: She walks every day to stay in good shape.

options.explanation: casual lifestyle sentence naturally uses stay in good shape。
be slim focuses appearance, not fitness。
weigh less is only body weight。
exercise only is the action, not resulting condition。
be famous is unrelated。
be healthy only is broader and does not specifically convey fitness.

exercises.original: He wants to improve his fitness before the hiking trip.
exercises.zh: 他想在遠足前改善身體狀態。
exercises.upgrade: He wants to get in good shape before the hiking trip.

options.explanation: informal preparation for a physical trip fits get in good shape。
lose weight/become slim may happen but are not equivalent to fitness。
exercise is the method rather than the state。
gain muscle only is too narrow。
improve health only is broader.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: After a few months of regular training, she was much fitter.
exercises.zh: 定期訓練幾個月後，她的身體狀態好多了。
exercises.upgrade: After a few months of regular training, she was in much better shape.

options.explanation: better shape is a natural informal way to describe improved overall fitness。
slimmer/lighter are body-size changes, not fitness。
exercising is an activity。
healthier only is broader and not necessarily performance-related。
more muscular only is one component.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

falseSynonyms.zh: 健康不等於所有 fitness health 是更廣的身心狀況；一個人可沒有疾病但體能很差。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Health is broader than physical fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 力量不等於 fitness strength 只是體適能的一個組成部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Strength is one component of fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 耐力不等於整體 fitness stamina 只強調持久力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stamina covers endurance, not total fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 體重不等於 fitness weight 是身體重量；較輕或較重都不能單獨證明體能好壞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Body weight alone does not measure fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 瘦不等於 fitness 身形纖瘦不代表心肺、肌力或耐力良好。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Being slim does not necessarily mean being fit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 肌肉不等於 fitness 肌肉量只是身體組成或力量相關因素，不能代表整體體適能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Muscle mass is not the same as overall fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 運動不等於 fitness exercise 是活動／行為；fitness 是身體能力或狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exercise can improve fitness, but it is not fitness itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 fit 是形容詞；fitness 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fit is an adjective; fitness is a noun.
